energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Built-in laptop chip energy counters and physics bounds; no external wall meter.

claims.statement: An agent must aim at a goal, act on the world, and stay within an energy budget.
Physics prices every decision, creating one optimal pace between slow idle drain and frantic switching waste.
Among systems that finish a task correctly, the smarter one is whichever spent less energy.
Headline outcome: Finish Right First, Then Rank by Joules (Built-in laptop chip energy counters and physics bounds; no external wall meter.)

three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about goals, pace, and saving energy.
An agent must aim at a goal, act on the world, and stay within an energy budget.
Physics prices every decision, creating one optimal pace between slow idle drain and frantic switching waste.
Among systems that finish a task correctly, the smarter one is whichever spent less energy.
Key result: Finish Right First, Then Rank by Joules.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
